## Description

Spin-on oil filter, part number 15208-AD200, for passenger cars. the parameters here are reference-grade, not source-confirmed. In practice the mounting thread and the gasket seat decide whether the part bolts up and seals; the media and the bypass valve then decide whether it protects. Buyers should pull the spec sheet and verify thread pitch, gasket diameter and the relief-valve setting before buying in volume.
